_comment: bb-ystl.3 (QD.3): Stryker on Bun via command-runner. Stryker itself runs under Node (bunx stryker invokes it as a Node process). The test-runner subprocess is `bun test` (the project's actual unit-test runner per ADR-2008). Direct bun:test ↔ Stryker integration doesn't exist; the command runner just shells out per mutant and reads the exit code, so no test-API churn is required.
_initialScopeComment: QD.3 initial scope is intentionally narrow: only the modules covered by sandbox-safe (mock-based or pure) tests. The fixture-based suites (createBdWorkspace tmpdirs, real bd CLI calls) don't survive Stryker's sandbox copy without extra fixture wiring — see docs/quality/2026-04-27/mutation/server-baseline.md for the failure mode. Widening scope is a follow-up bead (see DONE comment on bb-ystl.3). Initial measured score on this scope clears the configured 40% floor by a wide margin (84.62%), so the gate is live and meaningful immediately.
